events.title: Solar particle storm
events.fact: On 11 Sep 2017, NASA's Curiosity rover measured more than twice the normal radiation here at Gale Crater, after a huge eruption on the Sun.

events.title: Dust storm
events.fact: In 2018 a dust storm covered the whole planet. Sunlight dropped so much that NASA's solar-powered Opportunity rover could not recharge, and it went silent.
